Dwarves of Escarth discover a small ruin of an Aelari city that teaches them the secrets of invocations and magical forging. They make their first city at this location, the Mountain of Bourn Dorhul, which houses the heart of a dead Titan from the Titan war. This begins the era of Dwarven enlightenment and marks the first construction of the Dwarf-Forged constructs. They also discover the secrets and methods of forging Adamantine.
